summary_en: This work introduces dual-frequency ultrasonic holography using a single binary aperture plate optimized by a multi-frequency optimal accumulation algorithm. The added frequency degree of freedom lets one passive binary-amplitude element encode distinct acoustic intensity patterns at two operating frequencies. The authors validate geometric, letter, and numeral projections theoretically, numerically, and experimentally in water using a drilled stainless-steel plate. Because the contribution directly advances coded acoustic holography and multi-frequency wavefield synthesis, it is a core repository addition.
